description: This file is a shell script primarily used for testing git commit race conditions, particularly focusing on orphan commit creation and non-orphan commit creation scenarios.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with the provided content and sets executable permissions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the previous command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or strings.

methods.name: test_done
